case.name: wide_exponent_signed_underflow
case.compiler_discrepancy: GNU 14.2 returns nonzero SET_EXPONENT for I=-HUGE(0_8). The bounded interpreter contract returns signed zero without narrowing the exponent. This case has an independent signed-zero oracle, not a GNU runtime equivalence claim.
case.scope_note: Extreme INTEGER8 exponent policy independently tested; GNU compiles only.

case.name: metadata_no_evaluation
case.scope_note: Descriptor-only KIND contract; GNU compilation only, never execute undefined/unallocated metadata probes.

case.name: iachar_nonascii
case.scope_note: Single high-byte literal tests IACHAR ASCII policy directly, without failing earlier in CHAR/ACHAR.
